messages.subject: Managing the display of multiple plots
parts:
Hi

The DT:renderDataTable elegantly breaks down a table of data into a nicely displayed group of rows and provide for controls to switch from one group to another. Is there something similar in the Shiny world to manage the display of a series of plots (something like a list of ggplot objects or the output of a lattice xyplot call resulting in multiple pages of plots)?

The length of the series is anticipated to not be fixed in the app I am playing with.

Thanks
